job: Name an icon-only control or reveal its shortcut on hover or focus.
purpose: One tooltip element serves the whole page. It waits 350ms the first time, then follows the pointer from one control to the next with no delay, and disappears on leave, press or scroll. Keyboard focus shows it at once. It never takes the pointer. Icon-only triggers without a name get the text as their aria-label.
useWhen: An icon-only button needs a name.
A control has a keyboard shortcut to show (data-shortcut).

avoidWhen.when: The content has links or actions.
A preview of the thing a link points to.
The text is needed by everyone, such as a field label.
A helper line under a form control.

states.name: open
states.how: data-state="open"; shown after 350ms or on focus

states.name: described
states.how: aria-describedby links the trigger while visible

parts.role: The shortcut keys at the end.

keyboard.does: Focusing the trigger shows the tooltip at once.
